title: 2523. Closest Prime Numbers in Range

examples.explanation: The prime numbers between 10 and 19 are 11, 13, 17, and 19. The closest gap between any pair is 2, which can be achieved by [11,13] or [17,19]. Since 11 is smaller than 17, we return the first pair.
There exists only one prime number in the given range, so the conditions cannot be satisfied.
